title: Auditory Cognition
summary: Extends FRIDAY from a speech assistant into understanding of the whole auditory environment. Environmental sounds are detected by an open, plugin-based catalog, interpreted into contextual AUDIO Observations routed through Perception -> Entity Resolver -> World Model (no bypass), remembered (meaningful only), and prioritized by Audio Attention. The speech path gains confidence-gated wake control (self-speech aware, cooldown, resume) and de-duplication. Built additively on the M12.1 Listening pipeline, which is not modified.
builds_on: M12.1 (core/audio/listener) — continuous listening, VAD, wake engine, transcription, events bus
must_never: write the World Model bypassing entity resolution
crash the Cognitive Core on an audio failure
pipeline: Microphone frames -> Audio Event Engine (features -> detectors) -> Context Reasoner -> Observation(AUDIO) -> Perception -> Entity Resolver -> World Model; + Auditory Memory + Audio Attention; speech: Transcript -> Dedup -> Wake Control

components.config: AudioCognitionConfig (wake/speech/events/memory/attention) — flat YAML 'audio:' block or nested sections
components.features: numpy rFFT + time-domain features (energy, zcr, centroid, bandwidth, flatness, rolloff, band ratios, harmonicity, pitch, onsets, modulation)
components.detectors: ProfileDetector (model-free feature templates, always available) + MLEventDetector (learned-classifier hook). Sounds are data (profiles), not code.
components.engine: AudioEventEngine — rolling-window detection, confidence gate, per-type cooldown, emits AuditoryEvent
components.context: AudioContextReasoner — sound -> contextual AUDIO Observation + reasoning, routed via perception (no bypass)
components.memory: AuditoryMemory — SQLite store of meaningful events (ts/type/confidence/source/session); optional Chronicle forward
components.attention: AudioAttention — priority bands emergency>wake>speech>environmental>background, dynamic, M5 integration
components.wake: WakeWordController — confidence threshold, cooldown, self-speech suppression, resume-after-speaking (wraps M12.1 WakeWordEngine)
components.dedup: SpeechDeduplicator — rejects identical/near-identical transcripts within a window

extensibility: Add a sound = register a SoundType + a FeatureProfile (data); no engine/core change. ML detectors plug in via MLEventDetector.set_classifier.
public_api: AuditoryCognition(config?, runtime?, perception?, world_model?, attention_system?, chronicle?, executive?, emotion?, wake_engine?)
invariants: every detected sound becomes an AuditoryEvent; meaningful ones become Observations + memories
context observations never bypass entity resolution (routed via perception)
no detector writes the World Model directly
detection runs off the capture thread and never raises
an audio failure can never crash the Cognitive Core
M12.1 listening pipeline is unmodified (additive integration)
no hardcoded tunables; no side effects at import
